scope: Career Mode 2.0 Amateur Career age, phase transition, development carryover and generated-boxer seed evidence. Training-minigame internals are intentionally out of scope.

evidence: Fresh-career initializer 0x0019CFF8 loads literal 0x14 (20) at 0x0019D0E0 and stores it to profile+0x41 at 0x0019D280.
A roster-derived initialization path calls 0x00185434 and stores the returned age both to the player's progression record+0x09 and profile+0x41.
Population initializer writes the output of XDB boxer helper 0x00185434 into progression record+0x09.
Annual world-aging routine 0x00195810 increments progression record+0x09 when the annual date boundary is crossed.
Population retirement/inactivation routine 0x00195990 uses +0x09 in its age-related decisions.
Generated-population initialization assigns +0x11 independently from current age.
A progression maintenance path can copy current age +0x09 into +0x11 under state/ordering conditions.
baseline_age_field.boundary: The field participates in age/career-span logic, but the exact original member name is not retained.

evidence: 0x00185434 reads XDB boxer field 0x0D and returns its low byte.
Career population initialization writes that return value to progression record+0x09 current age.
Player initialization also mirrors the same value to profile+0x41.

high_byte.use: feeds career calendar-year/date initialization through date helper 0x001A0E1C
high_byte.confidence: CONFIRMED arithmetic/use; exact semantic label unresolved
high_byte.warning: Do not rename this byte 'birth year' without stronger evidence.

behavior: Copies the current player's 0x34-byte progression record to temporary storage.
Preserves/copies the persistent player boxer block at profile+0x256C and synchronizes it through 0x0018ADCC.
Restores/rewrites the player progression record after the transition.
phase_0_to_1.significance: The intermediate career transition preserves both player progression-record state and persistent boxer attributes instead of rebuilding the boxer.

phase_1_to_2.trigger_context: Named Go Pro contract type 23 reaches this function through 0x001A38C4.

combined_transition_controller.confidence: CONFIRMED behavior; exact public method name unresolved
behavior: When phase is 0, performs setup and calls 0x001948C0 to enter phase 1.
When phase is 1, adds 20,000 (0x4E20) to three money/earnings-like profile totals at +0xA0/+0xA4/+0x94, then calls 0x0019DC80 to enter phase 2.
combined_transition_controller.implication: Career Mode 2.0 can preserve amateur development, rival/history metadata and new potential/growth state across the existing phase transition rather than reconstructing a new professional boxer.

generated_boxer_archetype_seed.confidence: CONFIRMED packed seed extraction and rating-generation use; semantic names of components unresolved

behavior: Uses progression record+0x0E to select a base rating-profile table.
Uses record+0x0F and signed record+0x10 to alter the generated rating distribution/style.
Writes persistent boxer ratings in the block containing +0x7A..+0x8A.

generated_boxer_archetype_seed.boundary: These bytes are useful generated-boxer archetype/style seeds. They are NOT evidence of hidden potential ceilings or learning-rate fields.

confirmed_existing_support: persistent current age and annual aging
six-division world simulation and AI population aging
potential_and_growth_gap.design_consequence: Career Mode 2.0 should plan to add potential/learning-rate/growth data unless subsequent static evidence identifies an existing field. Existing archetype bytes must not be silently repurposed as potential without proving their unused value range and all consumers.

next_static_step: Map the persistent player's weight/height/reach fields and their UI/accessor consumers.
Trace weight-class reassignment after boxer-data changes to identify a safe physical-growth/weight-class transition boundary.
Identify unused/reserved save capacity appropriate for new potential, learning-rate and growth-projection data.
Trace title/award and legacy sources after the physical-growth storage map is bounded.
